Mint costs a single FHE operation.  2. NOBODY but this contract is ever allowed on the seed. A holder allowed on it could     decrypt everything through the relayer and skip the game. `shake` hands out a fresh     ciphertext holding one trait; that is the only thing a holder can decrypt.  3. proof.\n///\n///  HCU per function (FHE cost, protocol limit 20,000,000 per transaction), measured in tests:\n///    mint           24,000 per box   one randEuint64\n///    shake         ~672,000          randEuint16, 4 scalar ge, 4 select, 1 encrypted shr\n///    proveAlive     ~58,000          one scalar lt on 16 bits\n///    observe             0           ACL change only\n///    finalize*           0           signature check only\ncontract DoNotOpen is ERC721, Ownable, ZamaEthereumConfig {\n    enum BoxStatus {\n        Sealed,\n        Observing,\n        Revealed\n    }\n\n    enum AliveCheck {\n        None,\n        Pending,\n        Alive,\n        NotAlive\n    }\n\n    struct Revealed {\n        uint64 seed;\n        uint8 state;\n        uint8[5] traits;\n        uint16 score;\n        bool golden;\n    }\n\n    /// @dev What one viewer got from their latest shake of one box.\n    struct Shake {\n        /// Bit offset of the picked trait inside the seed (see the seed layout in game-spec).\n        euint8 pick;\n        /// The picked trait's roll.\n        euint8 roll;\n    }\n\n    error InvalidQuantity();\n    error SoldOut();\n    error WrongPayment(uint256 expected);\n    error NotHolder();\n    error NotSealed();\n    error NotObserving();\n    error AliveCheckAlreadyRequested();\n    error AliveCheckNotPending();\n    error WithdrawFailed();\n\n    event Minted(uint256 indexed tokenId, address indexed owner);\n    /// @dev Which trait was picked is deliberately absent: only the viewer can decrypt it.\n    event Shaken(uint256 indexed tokenId, address indexed viewer, bool paid);\n    event ObserveRequested(uint256 indexed tokenId, bytes32 seedHandle);\n    event Observed(uint256 indexed tokenId, uint64 seed, uint8 state, uint16 rarityScore, bool golden);\n    event AliveCheckRequested(uint256 indexed tokenId, bytes32 aliveHandle);\n    event AliveProven(uint256 indexed tokenId, bool alive);\n\n    DoNotOpenConfig public immutable config;\n    uint256 public immutable mintPrice;\n    uint256 public immutable observeFee;\n\n    uint16 private immutable _maxSupply;\n    uint8 private immutable _maxPerTx;\n    uint16 private immutable _aliveBelow;\n    // Trait bit offsets, cached so a shake makes no external call.\n    uint8 private immutable _offset0;\n    uint8 private immutable _offset1;\n    uint8 private immutable _offset2;\n    uint8 private immutable _offset3;\n    uint8 private immutable _offset4;\n\n    // Splits a uniform 16-bit draw into five buckets: 13108 + 4 * 13107 = 65536.\n    uint16 private constant PICK_1 = 13108;\n    uint16 private constant PICK_2 = 26215;\n    uint16 private constant PICK_3 = 39322;\n    uint16 private constant PICK_4 = 52429;\n\n    uint256 public totalMinted;\n    string private _baseTokenURI;\n\n    mapping(uint256 tokenId => euint64) private _seed;\n    mapping(uint256 tokenId => BoxStatus) public status;\n    mapping(uint256 tokenId => Revealed) private _revealed;\n    mapping(uint256 tokenId => AliveCheck) public aliveCheck;\n    mapping(uint256 tokenId => ebool) private _aliveBit;\n    mapping(uint256 tokenId => mapping(address viewer => Shake)) private _shakes;\n\n    constructor(\n        DoNotOpenConfig config_,\n        uint256 mintPrice_,\n        uint256 observeFee_,\n        address owner_\n    ) ERC721(\"DO NOT OPEN\", \"DNO\") Ownable(owner_) {\n        config = config_;\n        mintPrice = mintPrice_;\n        observeFee = observeFee_;\n        _maxSupply = config_.maxSupply();\n        _maxPerTx = config_.maxPerTx();\n        _aliveBelow = config_.aliveBelow();\n        uint8[5] memory offsets = config_.traitOffsets();\n        _offset0 = offsets[0];\n        _offset1 = offsets[1];\n        _offset2 = offsets[2];\n        _offset3 = offsets[3];\n        _offset4 = offsets[4];\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ mint\n\n    /// @notice Mints `quantity` sealed boxes. Each gets its own encrypted random seed.\n    /// @dev The seed comes from the protocol's encrypted PRNG. Its value is unknown to the\n    ///      minter, the deployer and block producers, so there is nothing to front-run or grind.\n    ///      `_mint` is used instead of `_safeMint`: no receiver callback, no re-entrancy surface.\n    function mint(uint256 quantity) external payable {\n        if (quantity == 0 || quantity > _maxPerTx) revert InvalidQuantity();\n        uint256 first = totalMinted;\n        if (first + quantity > _maxSupply) revert SoldOut();\n        if (msg.value != mintPrice * quantity) revert WrongPayment(mintPrice * quantity);\n\n        totalMinted = first + quantity;\n        for (uint256 tokenId = first; tokenId < first + quantity; tokenId++) {\n            euint64 seed = FHE.randEuint64();\n            FHE.allowThis(seed);\n            _seed[tokenId] = seed;\n            _mint(msg.sender, tokenId);\n            emit Minted(tokenId, msg.sender);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ----------------------------------------------------------------- shake\n\n    /// @notice The holder learns ONE trait, picked at random by the contract. Unlimited.\n    /// @dev Never touches the state roll: the five possible picks are the five trait bytes.\n    /// @return pick encrypted bit offset of the picked trait inside the seed\n    /// @return roll encrypted roll of that trait\n    function shake(uint256 tokenId) external returns (euint8 pick, euint8 roll) {\n        if (ownerOf(tokenId) != msg.sender) revert NotHolder();\n        if (status[tokenId] != BoxStatus.Sealed) revert NotSealed();\n        (pick, roll) = _shakeFor(tokenId, msg.sender);\n        emit Shaken(tokenId, msg.sender, false);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev The pick is itself encrypted, so it cannot be predicted or ground by resubmitting.\n    ///      Both results are fresh ciphertexts; granting the viewer access to them says\n    ///      nothing about the seed they were cut from.\n    function _shakeFor(uint256 tokenId, address viewer) internal returns (euint8 pick, euint8 roll) {\n        euint16 draw = FHE.randEuint16();\n        pick = FHE.asEuint8(_offset0);\n        pick = FHE.select(FHE.ge(draw, PICK_1), FHE.asEuint8(_offset1), pick);\n        pick = FHE.select(FHE.ge(draw, PICK_2), FHE.asEuint8(_offset2), pick);\n        pick = FHE.select(FHE.ge(draw, PICK_3), FHE.asEuint8(_offset3), pick);\n        pick = FHE.select(FHE.ge(draw, PICK_4), FHE.asEuint8(_offset4), pick);\n        // Shift the picked byte down to bits 0..7; the downcast keeps only those.\n        roll = FHE.asEuint8(FHE.shr(_seed[tokenId], pick));\n\n        // The relayer requires the contract itself to be allowed on anything a user decrypts.\n        FHE.allowThis(pick);\n        FHE.allowThis(roll);\n        FHE.allow(pick, viewer);\n        FHE.allow(roll, viewer);\n        _shakes[tokenId][viewer] = Shake(pick, roll);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Handles of `viewer`'s latest shake of `tokenId`. Zero if they never shook it.\n    function lastShake(uint256 tokenId, address viewer) external view returns (euint8 pick, euint8 roll) {\n        Shake storage s = _shakes[tokenId][viewer];\n        return (s.pick, s.roll);\n    }\n\n    // --------------------------------------------------------------- observe\n\n    /// @notice Opens the box. Irreversible. Step 1 of 2: makes the seed publicly decryptable.\n    function observe(uint256 tokenId) external payable {\n        if (ownerOf(tokenId) != msg.sender) revert NotHolder();\n        if (status[tokenId] != BoxStatus.Sealed) revert NotSealed();\n        if (msg.value != observeFee) revert WrongPayment(observeFee);\n\n        status[tokenId] = BoxStatus.Observing;\n        FHE.makePubliclyDecryptable(_seed[tokenId]);\n        emit ObserveRequested(tokenId, FHE.toBytes32(_seed[tokenId]));\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Step 2 of 2. Anyone may submit the decrypted seed with its KMS proof.\n    /// @param abiEncodedSeed `abiEncodedClearValues` returned by the relayer's publicDecrypt\n    /// @param decryptionProof `decryptionProof` returned by the relayer's publicDecrypt\n    /// @dev The handle list is rebuilt from storage, never taken from the caller, so a valid\n    ///      proof for another box or another value cannot be replayed here.\n    function finalizeObserve(uint256 tokenId, bytes calldata abiEncodedSeed, bytes calldata decryptionProof) external {\n        if (status[tokenId] != BoxStatus.Observing) revert NotObserving();\n\n        bytes32[] memory handles = new bytes32[](1);\n        handles[0] = FHE.toBytes32(_seed[tokenId]);\n        FHE.checkSignatures(handles, abiEncodedSeed, decryptionProof);\n\n        uint64 seed = abi.decode(abiEncodedSeed, (uint64));\n        (uint8 state, uint8[5] memory traits, uint16 score) = config.decode(seed);\n\n        status[tokenId] = BoxStatus.Revealed;\n        _revealed[tokenId] = Revealed({seed: seed, state: state, traits: traits, score: score, golden: false});\n        emit Observed(tokenId, seed, state, score, false);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice True once the box has been opened and its contents stored in the clear.\n    function revealed(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (bool) {\n        return status[tokenId] == BoxStatus.Revealed;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Plaintext contents of an opened box. All zero while sealed.\n    function contentsOf(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (Revealed memory) {\n        return _revealed[tokenId];\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Handle of the encrypted seed. A handle is an identifier, not the value.\n    function seedHandle(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (bytes32) {\n        return FHE.toBytes32(_seed[tokenId]);\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------ proveAlive\n\n    /// @notice Step 1 of 2. Computes the single encrypted bit \"is it alive\" and makes that\n    ///         bit, and nothing else, publicly decryptable. One request per box.\n    /// @dev The answer becomes public whichever way it falls. A holder who suspects the\n    ///      worst should not ask.\n    function proveAlive(uint256 tokenId) external {\n        if (ownerOf(tokenId) != msg.sender) revert NotHolder();\n        if (status[tokenId] != BoxStatus.Sealed) revert NotSealed();\n        if (aliveCheck[tokenId] != AliveCheck.None) revert AliveCheckAlreadyRequested();\n\n        aliveCheck[tokenId] = AliveCheck.Pending;\n        // The state roll is the low 16 bits of the seed; \"alive\" is the lowest range.\n        ebool alive = FHE.lt(FHE.asEuint16(_seed[tokenId]), _aliveBelow);\n        FHE.allowThis(alive);\n        FHE.makePubliclyDecryptable(alive);\n        _aliveBit[tokenId] = alive;\n        emit AliveCheckRequested(tokenId, FHE.toBytes32(alive));\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Step 2 of 2. Anyone may submit the decrypted bit with its KMS proof.\n    function finalizeProveAlive(uint256 tokenId, bytes calldata abiEncodedAlive, bytes calldata decryptionProof) external {\n        if (aliveCheck[tokenId] != AliveCheck.Pending) revert AliveCheckNotPending();\n\n        bytes32[] memory handles = new bytes32[](1);\n        handles[0] = FHE.toBytes32(_aliveBit[tokenId]);\n        FHE.checkSignatures(handles, abiEncodedAlive, decryptionProof);\n\n        bool alive = abi.decode(abiEncodedAlive, (bool));\n        aliveCheck[tokenId] = alive ? AliveCheck.Alive : AliveCheck.NotAlive;\n        emit AliveProven(tokenId, alive);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Handle of the \"is alive\" bit, once requested.\n    function aliveHandle(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (bytes32) {\n        return FHE.toBytes32(_aliveBit[tokenId]);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The \"Vet Certified\" badge: the box was proven alive while still sealed.\n    function vetCertified(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (bool) {\n        return aliveCheck[tokenId] == AliveCheck.Alive;\n    }\n\n    // ----------------------------------------------------------------- admin\n\n    function setBaseURI(string calldata baseURI_) external onlyOwner {\n        _baseTokenURI = baseURI_;\n    }\n\n    function withdraw(address payable to) external onlyOwner {\n        (bool ok, ) = to.call{value: address(this).balance}(\"\");\n        if (!ok) revert WithdrawFailed();\n    }\n\n    function maxSupply() external view returns (uint256) {\n        return _maxSupply;\n    }\n\n    function maxPerTx() external view returns (uint256) {\n        return _maxPerTx;\n    }\n\n    function _baseURI() internal view override returns (string memory) {\n        return _baseTokenURI;\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x28888a03a1216ca660a5dece5ef8bf3e61bcb777602c47463ede8d7e41f9468d","license":"MIT"},"contracts/DoNotOpenConfig.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.24;\n\n/// @title DoNotOpenConfig\n/// @notice The numbers of the game, loaded once at deploy from `packages/game-spec/spec.json`,\n///         and the plaintext rules that turn a revealed seed into a cat.\n/// @dev Holds no FHE logic. Everything here is public by design: the secret is the seed,\n///      never the rules. Immutable after construction.\ncontract DoNotOpenConfig {\n    uint8 public constant TRAIT_COUNT = 5;\n    uint8 public constant STATE_COUNT = 4;\n\n    struct Params {\n        /// keccak256 of the spec.json these values were read from.\n        bytes32 specHash;\n        uint16 maxSupply;\n        uint8 maxPerTx;\n        /// Exclusive upper bound of the 16-bit state roll for states 0, 1 and 2.\n        /// State 3 owns everything above the last bound.\n        uint16[3] stateRollBelow;\n        uint16[4] stateScoreBonus;\n        /// Bit offset of each trait byte inside the 64-bit seed.\n        uint8[5] traitOffset;\n        uint8[5] traitWeight;\n        /// Per trait, one byte per variant: how many of the 256 rolls map to it.\n        bytes[5] variantWidths;\n        uint32 goldenThreshold;\n        uint16 goldenScoreBonus;\n    }\n\n    error InvalidStateThresholds();\n    error InvalidTraitOffset(uint8 trait);\n    error InvalidVariantWidths(uint8 trait);\n    error UnknownTrait(uint8 trait);\n\n    bytes32 public immutable specHash;\n    uint16 public immutable maxSupply;\n    uint8 public immutable maxPerTx;\n    uint32 public immutable goldenThreshold;\n    uint16 public immutable goldenScoreBonus;\n\n    uint16[3] private _stateRollBelow;\n    uint16[4] private _stateScoreBonus;\n    uint8[5] private _traitOffset;\n    uint8[5] private _traitWeight;\n    bytes[5] private _variantWidths;\n\n    constructor(Params memory p) {\n        if (p.stateRollBelow[0] == 0 || p.stateRollBelow[0] >= p.stateRollBelow[1] || p.stateRollBelow[1] >= p.stateRollBelow[2]) {\n            revert InvalidStateThresholds();\n        }\n        for (uint8 i = 0; i < TRAIT_COUNT; i++) {\n            // A trait byte must sit above the 16-bit state roll and inside the 64-bit seed.\n            if (p.traitOffset[i] < 16 || p.traitOffset[i] > 56) revert InvalidTraitOffset(i);\n            uint256 total;\n            bytes memory widths = p.variantWidths[i];\n            for (uint256 v = 0; v < widths.length; v++) total += uint8(widths[v]);\n            if (total != 256) revert InvalidVariantWidths(i);\n        }\n\n        specHash = p.specHash;\n        maxSupply = p.maxSupply;\n        maxPerTx = p.maxPerTx;\n        goldenThreshold = p.goldenThreshold;\n        goldenScoreBonus = p.goldenScoreBonus;\n        _stateRollBelow = p.stateRollBelow;\n        _stateScoreBonus = p.stateScoreBonus;\n        _traitOffset = p.traitOffset;\n        _traitWeight = p.traitWeight;\n        _variantWidths = p.variantWidths;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice State rolls below this value mean \"alive\".\n    function aliveBelow() external view returns (uint16) {\n        return _stateRollBelow[0];\n    }\n\n    function stateRollBelow() external view returns (uint16[3] memory) {\n        return _stateRollBelow;\n    }\n\n    function stateScoreBonus() external view returns (uint16[4] memory) {\n        return _stateScoreBonus;\n    }\n\n    function traitOffsets() external view returns (uint8[5] memory) {\n        return _traitOffset;\n    }\n\n    function traitWeights() external view returns (uint8[5] memory) {\n        return _traitWeight;\n    }\n\n    function variantWidths(uint8 trait) external view returns (bytes memory) {\n        if (trait >= TRAIT_COUNT) revert UnknownTrait(trait);\n        return _variantWidths[trait];\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Index of the variant a trait roll maps to.\n    function variantOf(uint8 trait, uint8 roll) external view returns (uint8) {\n        if (trait >= TRAIT_COUNT) revert UnknownTrait(trait);\n        bytes storage widths = _variantWidths[trait];\n        uint256 upper;\n        for (uint256 v = 0; v < widths.length; v++) {\n            upper += uint8(widths[v]);\n            if (roll < upper) return uint8(v);\n        }\n        // Unreachable: widths are validated to sum to 256.\n        revert InvalidVariantWidths(trait);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Everything a revealed seed determines. Mirrors `decodeSeed`, `stateFromRoll`\n    ///         and `rarityScore` in the TypeScript generator; a test keeps the two in step.\n    /// @return state 0 alive, 1 asleep, 2 ghost, 3 quantum\n    /// @return rolls the five trait bytes\n    /// @return score weighted sum of the rolls plus the state bonus (no golden bonus)\n    function decode(uint64 seed) public view returns (uint8 state, uint8[5] memory rolls, uint16 score) {\n        uint16 stateRoll = uint16(seed);\n        if (stateRoll >= _stateRollBelow[2]) state = 3;\n        else if (stateRoll >= _stateRollBelow[1]) state = 2;\n        else if (stateRoll >= _stateRollBelow[0]) state = 1;\n\n        score = _stateScoreBonus[state];\n        for (uint8 i = 0; i < TRAIT_COUNT; i++) {\n            rolls[i] = uint8(seed >> _traitOffset[i]);\n            score += uint16(_traitWeight[i]) * rolls[i];\n        }\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xf3a1343f8101fe942ad4986c465e8a208ab6c50628073c8628d4e783aea00128","license":"MIT"},"encrypted-types/EncryptedTypes.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma devdoc.details: Design notes. Read these before changing anything.  1. ONE ciphertext per box. State, traits and score are not stored encrypted: they are     derived from the seed when a function needs them. Mint costs a single FHE operation.  2. NOBODY but this contract is ever allowed on the seed. A holder allowed on it could     decrypt everything through the relayer and skip the game. `shake` hands out a fresh     ciphertext holding one trait; that is the only thing a holder can decrypt.  3. Because of (2) a transfer has no ACL to move and nothing to revoke. FHE.allow grants     are permanent on this protocol, so a design that granted the holder anything durable     could not take it back.  4. Public decryption has no on-chain callback. A request marks a ciphertext publicly     decryptable; anyone then fetches the cleartext and KMS proof off-chain and submits     them to the matching `finalize*` function, which verifies the proof.  HCU per function (FHE cost, protocol limit 20,000,000 per transaction), measured in tests:    mint           24,000 per box   one randEuint64    shake         ~672,000          randEuint16, 4 scalar ge, 4 select, 1 encrypted shr    proveAlive     ~58,000          one scalar lt on 16 bits    observe             0           ACL change only    finalize*           0           signature check only

ERC721NonexistentToken(uint256).details: Indicates a `tokenId` whose `owner` is the zero address.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

Approval(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `owner` enables `approved` to manage the `tokenId` token.

ApprovalForAll(address,address,bool).details: Emitted when `owner` enables or disables (`approved`) `operator` to manage all of its assets.

Shaken(uint256,address,bool).details: Which trait was picked is deliberately absent: only the viewer can decrypt it.

Transfer(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `tokenId` token is transferred from `from` to `to`.

approve(address,uint256).details: Gives permission to `to` to transfer `tokenId` token to another account. The approval is cleared when the token is transferred. Only a single account can be approved at a time, so approving the zero address clears previous approvals. Requirements: - The caller must own the token or be an approved operator. - `tokenId` must exist. Emits an {Approval} event.

balanceOf(address).details: Returns the number of tokens in ``owner``'s account.

finalizeObserve(uint256,bytes,bytes).details: The handle list is rebuilt from storage, never taken from the caller, so a valid      proof for another box or another value cannot be replayed here.

getApproved(uint256).details: Returns the account approved for `tokenId` token. Requirements: - `tokenId` must exist.

isApprovedForAll(address,address).details: Returns if the `operator` is allowed to manage all of the assets of `owner`. See {setApprovalForAll}

mint(uint256).details: The seed comes from the protocol's encrypted PRNG. Its value is unknown to the      minter, the deployer and block producers, so there is nothing to front-run or grind.      `_mint` is used instead of `_safeMint`: no receiver callback, no re-entrancy surface.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

ownerOf(uint256).details: Returns the owner of the `tokenId` token. Requirements: - `tokenId` must exist.

proveAlive(uint256).details: The answer becomes public whichever way it falls. A holder who suspects the      worst should not ask.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256.details: Safely transfers `tokenId` token from `from` to `to`, checking first that contract recipients are aware of the ERC-721 protocol to prevent tokens from being forever locked. Requirements: - `from` cannot be the zero address. - `to` cannot be the zero address. - `tokenId` token must exist and be owned by `from`. - If the caller is not `from`, it must have been allowed to move this token by either {approve} or   {setApprovalForAll}. - If `to` refers to a smart contract, it must implement {IERC721Receiver-onERC721Received}, which is called upon   a safe transfer. Emits a {Transfer} event.

Safely transfers `tokenId` token from `from` to `to`. Requirements: - `from` cannot be the zero address. - `to` cannot be the zero address. - `tokenId` token must exist and be owned by `from`. - If the caller is not `from`, it must be approved to move this token by either {approve} or {setApprovalForAll}. - If `to` refers to a smart contract, it must implement {IERC721Receiver-onERC721Received}, which is called upon   a safe transfer. Emits a {Transfer} event.

setApprovalForAll(address,bool).details: Approve or remove `operator` as an operator for the caller. Operators can call {transferFrom} or {safeTransferFrom} for any token owned by the caller. Requirements: - The `operator` cannot be the address zero. Emits an {ApprovalForAll} event.

shake(uint256).details: Never touches the state roll: the five possible picks are the five trait bytes.

returns.pick: encrypted bit offset of the picked trait inside the seed

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

tokenURI(uint256).details: Returns the Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) for `tokenId` token.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: Transfers `tokenId` token from `from` to `to`. WARNING: Note that the caller is responsible to confirm that the recipient is capable of receiving ERC-721 or else they may be permanently lost. Usage of {safeTransferFrom} prevents loss, though the caller must understand this adds an external call which potentially creates a reentrancy vulnerability. Requirements: - `from` cannot be the zero address. - `to` cannot be the zero address. - `tokenId` token must be owned by `from`. - If the caller is not `from`, it must be approved to move this token by either {approve} or {setApprovalForAll}. Emits a {Transfer} event.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

seedHandle(uint256).notice: Handle of the encrypted seed. A handle is an identifier, not the value.
